title.narrative: HIV Testing and Prevention in Cte dIvoire

description.narrative: The project will provide quality HIV prevention services, reaching and ensuring access to HIV testing, and also linking those KPs who test HIV positive to care, as well as providing HIV care and services in Cte dIvoire.
